post.description:
Register a dataset: creates its Iceberg table(s), as the caller.

`type: timeseries` (warehouse data model v1) builds the columns, key and
layout from the dataset's metadata, and a `<name>_series` series table unless
`series_table` names an existing one. Untyped datasets (`type: table`, the
default) are a test path: only platform admins may register them, unless
UNTYPED_DATASETS_FOR_MEMBERS is on.

get.description:
Read a dataset's rows, as the caller, a page at a time.

Every page of one read sees the same snapshot (the cursor pins it), so writes
landing meanwhile don't shift or duplicate rows. For bulk reads use Arrow or
Parquet; large exports belong in jobs.

parameters.description: Rows to return, e.g. location_id = 'usgs-01' and value_time >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00'
parameters.name: filter

schema.description: Rows to return, e.g. location_id = 'usgs-01' and value_time >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00'
schema.title: Filter

parameters.description: Also count the rows matching the filter
parameters.name: count

schema.description: Also count the rows matching the filter
schema.title: Count

200.description: A page of rows: JSON by default, or Arrow / Parquet when the Accept header asks. Every page carries X-Snapshot-Id.

400.description: Bad request (e.g. an invalid cursor or a page too large)

post.description:
Write rows to a dataset, as the caller. One snapshot per request.

For a timeseries, values are converted to the dataset's unit, and series keys
not yet in its series table are added there first (with the dataset's default
layer; existing series rows are left alone).

parameters.description: upsert (replace rows with the same key, add the rest; the default for timeseries and series tables; on a series table, columns left out keep their values), append (the default for untyped datasets; not allowed on typed ones), or overwrite. Timeseries writes must send every column (null where there's no value).
parameters.name: mode

schema.description: upsert (replace rows with the same key, add the rest; the default for timeseries and series tables; on a series table, columns left out keep their values), append (the default for untyped datasets; not allowed on typed ones), or overwrite. Timeseries writes must send every column (null where there's no value).
schema.title: Mode

parameters.description: overwrite only: replace only rows matching this filter, e.g. location_id = 'usgs-01' and value_time >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00'; without it the whole table is replaced
parameters.name: filter

schema.description: overwrite only: replace only rows matching this filter, e.g. location_id = 'usgs-01' and value_time >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00'; without it the whole table is replaced
schema.title: Filter

parameters.description: IANA time zone (e.g. America/Denver) that times without one are in, for timestamptz columns; they're stored as UTC. Without it, such times are refused.
parameters.name: timezone

schema.description: IANA time zone (e.g. America/Denver) that times without one are in, for timestamptz columns; they're stored as UTC. Without it, such times are refused.
schema.title: Timezone

parameters.description: Timeseries: the unit of `value` (UCUM, e.g. [cft_i]/s); converted to the dataset's unit. Default: the dataset's unit.
parameters.name: unit

schema.title: Unit
